description: This is a service class for managing ReadingGoal entities, providing methods to find, save, delete, and count goals within a Spring application.

classes.name: ReadingGoalService
classes.description: Service class handling business logic related to ReadingGoal entities, using Spring annotations.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves a ReadingGoal by its ID, returning an Optional to handle absence.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Returns a list of all ReadingGoals.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a ReadingGoal; currently overwrites previous goals by deleting all before saving.

methods.name: overwritePreviouslySetGoal
methods.description: Deletes all existing goals and saves the new goal to ensure only one goal exists at a time.

methods.name: deleteAll
methods.description: Deletes all ReadingGoals; based on comment, enforces the business rule of only one goal at a time.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of ReadingGoals currently stored.
